gap_pcm_real.text: Morning o. Naso I wake this morning see say POS wey i no use commot 50k for my account!
gap_pcm_real.en: Good morning. I woke up this morning and saw that ₦50,000 left my account through a POS I never used.

gap_yo_real.text: Ẹ káàrọ̀ o. Mo ra fóònù yìí ní ilé ìtajà yin ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá, ṣùgbọ́n kò ṣiṣẹ́ mọ́.
gap_yo_real.en: Good morning. I bought this phone from your shop last week, but it stopped working.
